record.question: Which of the following statements most accurately differentiates firmware from other types of software?
options: Firmware is application software installed by users for daily tasks
Firmware is permanently embedded in hardware and provides low-level control for device operation
Firmware runs only on cloud servers and not on local devices
Firmware is used only for network communication
